name: reviewer-upgrade-removal-guide
body:
Distributing `implementation-phase-reviewer` means a repo that already carries a repo-local `.opencode/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` will, after `apg init`, hit `apg init`'s duplicate-install warning. That warning is CORRECT and stays: `apg init` never deletes anything and warns loudly when a project's `.opencode/` holds files duplicating the installed suite. The upgrade guide (`APG_UPGRADE_DOC` in `src/install.rs`, installed at `~/.opencode/lib/apg-upgrade.md`) must tell users to MANUALLY remove their local `implementation-phase-reviewer.md` when upgrading to the release that first distributes it. Phrase it for that release: a generic "when upgrading to the release that first distributes the reviewer" is fine, and `0.18.0` may be named illustratively.

Acceptance criteria:
- `APG_UPGRADE_DOC` carries an explicit upgrade step and/or common-issue entry telling users to delete a repo-local `implementation-phase-reviewer.md` after upgrading to the first release that distributes it.
- `apg init`'s duplicate-install warning behaviour is unchanged: it still warns and still never deletes anything.
- `upgrade_doc_covers_version_field_gate_and_fix_steps` is extended with a reviewer-removal needle.
- Scope is `rust.apg.install` plus that one e2e test; no `apg init` behaviour change.
